title: The acceptance sighting preflight sends its control read over the shared host-reader connection: one sidecar id for every project
outcome: The named_root_sighting_read preflight (src/acceptance_named_root_sighting.rs) is the first control request sent over the Work view's host reader connection (session id termal-work-view). On the real ProcessEngramControlTransport this spawns a long-lived control sidecar keyed by that id alone. With two projects, the second project's read terminates the first project's sidecar (config mismatch) and a read in flight there fails, so that evaluation is refused as unknown. Nothing shuts the sidecar down except the idle timeout. The fix gives the host reader's sidecar a per-project identity (or a documented lifecycle), corrects the code comment that calls it the tracker reads' connection (those are CLI commands), and confirms with Engram that a sidecar started without session_bind registers no tracker session.
acceptance: Concurrent sighting preflights for two projects do not terminate each other's control sidecar; a test shows both reads complete.
The comment describing the read's connection is accurate, and the sidecar's lifecycle is documented.
